about_short_description.short_description: Lead is a Banking as a Service platform providing financial solutions for individuals, businesses, and fintech companies.

product.name: BaaS Partner Platform
product.description: An API-first platform enabling businesses to build and scale embedded financial products including lending, transfers, cards, and accounts.

product.name: Lending Solutions
product.description: Origination and disbursement of term loans, lines of credit, and credit cards for consumer and commercial borrowers.

product.name: Transfers
product.description: Services to send and receive funds via ACH, wire, internal transfers, and checks with real-time status updates.

product.name: Card Programs
product.description: Issuance and management of debit, prepaid, credit, and charge card programs with flexible network and processor options.

product.name: Account Services
product.description: Creation and management of FDIC-insured bank accounts with multiple virtual account numbers and FBO account structures.
